about: Announcements shown on the Home page of the Tohyee server app (Windows), next to the GitHub releases. Edit this file on main and GitHub Pages publishes it to https://willy-nz.github.io/Tohyee/news.json. Each item: date (YYYY-MM-DD), title, body, and optionally link (https) and kind ("conference" shows it in the conference card).

items.title: Save the date: TohyeeCon
items.body: The first Tohyee conference is coming to Ōtepoti Dunedin… one day. Date to be confirmed (probably after payroll is built). 🐶
